KCD signal endianess attribute incorrectly processed

Description

When loading KCD files with signal endianess attributes, the endianess value is being applied to all signals regardless of whether they actually have the endianess attribute specified. This causes signals without explicit endianess to incorrectly inherit endianess values from other attributes.

Steps/Code to Reproduce

```python
import cantools

# Load a KCD file with signals that have endianess attributes
db = cantools.database.load_file('tests/files/kcd/the_homer.kcd')

# This will fail with overlapping signals error due to incorrect endianess processing
message = db.get_message_by_name('LittleBigEndianAuto')
```

The issue occurs when parsing KCD signal elements where the endianess attribute processing logic incorrectly assigns endianess values to signals that don't have this attribute specified.
